deviations.summary: A face whose outer line looks twisted (lineTwistedFaces) adds no observations on that frame, and the whole frame's AWB step is withheld (not committed to the fragment) when any face is line-twisted; mapper.py records the face's observations until the 5-frame streak fires and always applies the AWB step.
deviations.reason: a line-twisted face adds no samples, so a twist seen soon after the face is first observed is still detected instead of being absorbed into its short history
deviations.note: Part (a) sessions: no compared difference; reverting D1 alone makes Kotlin miss pyspike-7's frame-83 twist (the twisted samples enter history and I401 no longer counts the blend as a sticker colour), so D1 and I401 cancel there. pyspike-d1-early-twist-u-v1 (U twist at frame 32): mapper.py records the twisted top rows while its streak builds and never detects the twist; Kotlin detects it at frame 36. Truth: Kotlin wrong 0 / FAILED (correct), mapper.py wrong 0 / PARTIAL (not correct): not worse, keep. Attribution: with D1 switched to mapper.py's behaviour in the working tree (line-twisted faces recorded, AWB step applied) Kotlin also ends PARTIAL and MapperParityReplayTest fails with 144 entries: the 119 D1 entries of pyspike-d1-early-twist-u-v1 stale and 25 unlisted pyspike-7 entries (the missed frame-83 twist).

deviations.summary: normalizeLogAwbInPlace bounds the zero-mean log-AWB by scaling all three channels jointly so the largest |channel| is 0.36 (keeps the chromaticity direction); mapper.py clips each channel to [-0.36, 0.36] independently.
deviations.reason: joint scaling keeps the cast direction when the log-AWB passes the bound; per-channel clipping distorts it and is never better here
deviations.note: Part (a) sessions: no compared difference (|log_awb| peaks at 0.315 < 0.36). pyspike-d2-strong-cast-v1 (gains ramping to exp(0, -0.9, -1.2)): the zero-mean log-AWB passes 0.36 on two channels; the bounds differ and Kotlin commits B5 one frame earlier (net and cue frame 116). Truth: Kotlin wrong 0 / COMPLETE, mapper.py wrong 0 / COMPLETE (both correct): tie, keep. Attribution: with per-channel clipping in the working tree the 2 D2 entries go stale and MapperParityReplayTest fails.

deviations.summary: tryMergePending rescales each merged pending observation's rgbAwb by master's AWB scale and adds pending's logAwb into master's (then renormalises); mapper.py copies rgb_awb unchanged and leaves master's log_awb untouched.
deviations.reason: adding the pending fragment's log-AWB at a merge keeps the cast that drifted during the pending life; mapper.py loses it and never completes
deviations.note: Part (a) sessions: no compared difference (pyspike-1 merges once with |log_awb| < 0.02). pyspike-d3-regrip-cast-drift-v1 (pastel F2L regrip, gains ramping to exp(0, -0.6, -0.9) over frames 68-88 while the pending fragment lives; it merges at 87 with log_awb (0.19, -0.04, -0.16)): from frame 88 mapper.py keeps cueing KeepTurningRealign and never anchors again, Kotlin anchors at 95 and completes. Truth: Kotlin wrong 0 / COMPLETE (correct), mapper.py wrong 0 / PARTIAL with 0 committed (not correct): not worse, keep. Attribution: with the merge AWB rescale and log-AWB add removed in the working tree Kotlin matches mapper.py there and MapperParityReplayTest fails with the 128 D3 entries stale. Reverting D4 alone also moves 4 of them (cue 94-95, net and globalAnchored 95), but D3 is the first cause: D3 alone removes them all.

deviations.summary: The shared-edge contradiction guard in attachBySharedEdge compares the candidate centre against the confirmed face's history in AWB-compensated shading-invariant Lab; mapper.py compares the raw (uncompensated) centre Lab.
deviations.reason: comparing the AWB-compensated centre with the AWB-compensated history compares like with like; the raw centre under a strong cast is not, and it is never better here
deviations.note: Part (a) sessions: no compared difference. pyspike-d4-pastel-strong-cast-v1 (pastel, own drift off, gains ramping to exp(0, -0.9, -1.2)): late in the scan mapper.py's raw-Lab guard refuses returning faces and it falls into the pending cues (frames 113-119), Kotlin keeps ResolveConflict(U). Truth: Kotlin wrong 3 / PARTIAL, mapper.py wrong 3 / PARTIAL (neither correct): tie, keep. Attribution: with the raw centre Lab in the guard in the working tree MapperParityReplayTest fails with 11 stale entries: the 7 D4 entries and 4 D3 entries of pyspike-d3-regrip-cast-drift-v1 (see D3).

deviations.summary: Issue #401 twist guard: a cell counts as flipped only when both its history and its new colour lie within dE 14 of a sticker prototype (twistStickerPrototypes / isStickerColour); mapper.py counts any dE > 33 change that is not a glare wash-out.
deviations.reason: a covered outer line whose new colour is no sticker colour is not a layer turn, so a finger no longer fails the scan
deviations.note: Part (a) sessions: no compared difference on its own (see D1 for the interaction). pyspike-i401-skin-occluder-v1 (skin-tone patch over F cells 6-7 on frames 14-21): mapper.py counts the covered line as flipped for five frames and reports a twist at frame 18; Kotlin's guard rejects the skin colour and completes. Truth: Kotlin wrong 0 / COMPLETE (correct), mapper.py wrong 0 / FAILED (not correct): not worse, keep. Attribution: with the sticker-colour guard off in the working tree Kotlin also fails at frame 18 and MapperParityReplayTest fails with the 445 I401 entries stale.

deviations.summary: Issue #402: each per-cell observation list is capped at MAX_OBS_PER_CELL = 256 (lowest quality dropped); mapper.py appends without bound.
deviations.reason: the cap bounds per-frame time and heap on a long scan; on a 525-frame hold it only shifts when a covered cell turns back, and the final net is equal
deviations.note: Part (a) sessions: no compared difference (longest per-cell list 84). pyspike-i402-long-hold-v1 (525 frames, a 275-frame hold with a magenta patch over F cell 1, then F frontal without it): F's lists pass 256, so Kotlin's capped list lets the patch uncommit F1 one frame earlier (frame 423) and the true colour back three frames earlier (frames 482-484). Truth: Kotlin wrong 0 / COMPLETE, mapper.py wrong 0 / COMPLETE (both correct): tie, keep. Attribution: with the cap removed in the working tree the 8 I402 entries go stale and MapperParityReplayTest fails.

deviations.summary: Once a twist is detected, processFrame returns at once (LayerTwistDetected, no tracked quads, no sampling); on the detecting frame tracked/frameCount are not updated. mapper.py keeps tracking, sampling and updating trackers after the twist (only observation recording and the colour solve stop).
deviations.note: No compared difference: net and cue are frozen after a twist in both mappers. Visible only in the uncompared trackedQuads of pyspike-7 frames 83-94 (frame 83 shows the previous frame's quads, then none). Reverting it changes no compared field.

deviations.summary: computeCue returns AllVerified first, whenever 54 stickers are committed with no conflict and the net validates as a cube, even with no tracked quad or with a pending fragment, and a 54-sticker net that does not validate gives ResolveConflict(globalInvalidFace); mapper.py checks AllVerified only after BringIntoView, the pending cues and the 6-face check, on 54 committed with no conflict.
deviations.note: No compared difference: every session's 54-committed frames also track a quad with no pending fragment. Reverting it changes no compared field.

deviations.summary: The TurnRemaining / TiltAwayLightRemaining side count (and the gate before the conflict and sticker cues) uses master's confirmed faces (>= 2 observations, centre quality >= 0.40); mapper.py uses master's observed faces, so it reports fewer remaining sides earlier.
deviations.note: The only cause of compared differences in the part (a) sessions (20 cue frames), and of the early cue differences of every part (b) session (frame 0 and while a newly observed face is not yet confirmed). Reverting it (observed faces) removes all of them.

deviations.summary: An empty frame resets hasPrevUnattached, so an unanchored single quad must reappear on two consecutive non-empty frames to start master; mapper.py keeps _prev_unattached across empty frames.
deviations.note: No compared difference: reverting it changes no compared field in these sessions.

deviations.summary: A pending fragment with no live tracker is reset on the first unmatched frame (the extra curPending.tracked.isEmpty() condition); mapper.py waits for its miss streak (1, or 3 once pending has a confirmed face).
deviations.note: No compared difference: reverting it changes no compared field in these sessions.

deviations.summary: filterPlausibleQuads also drops non-finite, non-convex and non-clockwise (signed area <= 0) quads and observations with non-finite samples; mapper.py filters by area and angle quality only.
deviations.note: No compared difference: synth_video.py quads are all finite, convex and clockwise. Reverting it changes no compared field.

deviations.summary: Every pending-to-master promotion (promotePendingToMaster) also clears the net, slot support, conflicts and centre prototypes; mapper.py keeps the previous net and conflicts until the next anchored colour solve replaces them.
deviations.note: No compared difference: reverting it changes no compared field in these sessions.

deviations.summary: ResolveConflict names the first conflicted slot in URFDLB face order (FaceSlot ordering); mapper.py sorts slots by face letter (B < D < F < L < R < U).
deviations.note: No conflict cue in the part (a) sessions. pyspike-d4-pastel-strong-cast-v1 frames 107-112: mapper.py names D first (face letter order), Kotlin U (URFDLB order); reverting it removes those 6 cue entries.

deviations.summary: Story 10.37 E9: when the built-in 3-5-centre anchor fails, a saved calibration passed to processFrame may anchor the orientation (SavedCalibrationAnchor: best of 24 orientations with average standard-Lab dE < 20 and margin >= 8, every observed centre CONFIDENT as its colour and within MAX_CENTRE_DELTA_E, torch tag equal to the torch lit). The anchor is never latched, a torch change after centre evidence turns the calibration off until reset, any ambiguous six-centre solve bars it from the fragment, and the #401 twist guard and both pending-to-master promotion rules of tryMergePending treat a calibration-made anchor as unanchored. mapper.py has no saved calibration. Deliberate, with no verdict: no parity session can carry a saved calibration.
deviations.note: No compared difference: no parity or replay session carries a saved calibration or a torch state, so every session runs the calibration-less path (recorded sessions store neither; see deferred-work.md). Covered by ContinuousSavedCalibrationTest.
